title: LexiHK Debuts at Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 and Is Officially Selected as a Designated LawTech Service Provider of the Department of Justice
summary: LexiHK made its Hong Kong Legal Week debut with live demonstrations, industry exchanges and selection as a designated provider under the Department of Justice LawTech funding scheme.
body: ## Overview On 2 November, Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 opened for a five-day run under the theme “Collaboration and Innovation: Legal Synergy for a Shared Future”. As the annual flagship event of the Department of Justice of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, this year’s Legal Week brings together legal practitioners, business representatives, policymakers and representatives of international organisations from around the world. LexiHK, the legal artificial intelligence product of the Hong Kong Generative AI Research and Development Center (HKGAI), appears at Hong Kong Legal Week for the first time, presenting through product demonstrations and a dedicated presentation how the technology is actually being applied in Hong Kong legal scenarios. During the event, Mr Paul Lam Ting-kwok (GBS, SC, JP), Secretary for Justice, Mr Horace Cheung Kwok-kwan (SBS, JP), Deputy Secretary for Justice, and a number of other guests visited the LexiHK booth to exchange views with the LexiHK research and development team and learn about the product’s functions and development progress. Professor Sirui Han, Head of LexiHK, also took the Insight Stage to deliver a dedicated presentation grounded in real legal work scenarios, showing how LexiHK supports research, streamlines processes and improves efficiency. PART 01　Guests from the Liaison Office, the Department of Justice and the Law Society of Hong Kong Visit the LexiHK Booth On 4 November, Mr Paul Lam Ting-kwok (GBS, SC, JP), Secretary for Justice, and Mr Horace Cheung Kwok-kwan (SBS, JP), Deputy Secretary for Justice, visited the LexiHK booth, watched product demonstrations and posed for a group photograph with the team. The two sides exchanged views on how artificial intelligence can serve Hong Kong’s legal sector, and the team focused on introducing LexiHK’s practice in applying local legal knowledge, supporting professional research and assisting work processes. On 5 November, Ms Yuan Gujie, Deputy Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Mr Liu Chunhua, Director-General of its Legal Affairs Department, visited the LexiHK booth to learn about LexiHK’s research and development achievements and its exploration of applications for Hong Kong’s legal sector. Drawing on the on-site demonstrations, the team introduced LexiHK’s strengths in supporting legal research, improving work efficiency and meeting local professional needs, illustrating the potential of artificial intelligence to empower Hong Kong legal services. In addition, Mr Roden M. L. Tong, President of the Law Society of Hong Kong, Mr Amirali B. Nasir, Vice-President, and other guests also visited the LexiHK booth to exchange views with the LexiHK team and learn about the product’s functions and application scenarios. The team explained to the Law Society of Hong Kong how LexiHK addresses the day-to-day needs of Hong Kong solicitors by providing intelligent assistance for legal research, document analysis and drafting, and presented its strengths in improving work efficiency and meeting local professional needs, again illustrating the potential of artificial intelligence to empower Hong Kong legal services. PART 02　A Live Demonstration at the Insight Stage: A New Intelligent Experience for Legal Work On the morning of 5 November, Professor Sirui Han, Head of LexiHK, delivered a dedicated LexiHK presentation and feature demonstration at the Insight Stage of the Hong Kong Legal Tech Festival, placing the product’s capabilities within a continuous legal work scenario and showing how artificial intelligence can start from a specific question and help complete source retrieval, information structuring and first-draft preparation. The demonstration followed work steps familiar to legal professionals. As the question was entered, sources were retrieved and analysis was organised step by step, LexiHK presented the whole process from a research need to a preliminary output. In view of the importance that legal work attaches to verifying authorities, the demonstration also showed how the relevant sources support users’ further review, effectively connecting intelligent assistance with professional oversight. From “finding the material” to “putting the material to use”, and from a single task to a continuous workflow, LexiHK demonstrated further possibilities for integrating artificial intelligence into legal practice. The demonstration also made the thinking behind the product visible, turning technical capability into work support that legal professionals can understand, operate and evaluate. ## PART 03　Deepening Industry Exchange and Opening New Opportunities in LawTech During the exhibition, the LexiHK team held in-depth exchanges with representatives of legal technology companies and professional service providers active in the Hong Kong market, including LexisNexis and Wolters Kluwer, sharing experience on the application of artificial intelligence in legal research, document processing and professional workflows, and discussing the real needs of Hong Kong’s legal sector and the room for cooperation. Drawing on its research and development experience in Hong Kong legal scenarios, the LexiHK team introduced the product’s exploration in applying local legal resources, tracing information sources and building intelligent assistance workflows, and exchanged views with industry partners on connecting technology with professional services. The exhibition proved an important opportunity for LexiHK to expand industry contacts and deepen understanding of cooperation; the team posed for photographs with representatives of a number of exhibiting organisations, establishing contacts for subsequent product refinement and cooperation, and jointly advancing the application and development of lawtech in Hong Kong. PART 04　LexiHK Selected as a Designated Supplier under the Department of Justice LawTech Funding Scheme ## Department of Justice LawTech Funding Scheme On 3 November, the Department of Justice officially launched the Funding Scheme for LawTech Solution Subscription by the Hong Kong Legal Sector, and LexiHK was selected as one of the 14 designated lawtech service providers. The scheme is one of the policy measures under the Chief Executive’s 2026 Policy Address and is jointly administered by the Law Society of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Bar Association. It targets law firms operating as sole proprietorships or with no more than five partners, and barristers with no more than seven years of call, subsidising their one-year service subscriptions on an actual-expense reimbursement basis. Each applicant may receive up to HK$20,000, and the application deadline is 29 January 2027. Law firms may apply through the Law Society of Hong Kong, and barristers through the Hong Kong Bar Association. To apply, scan or long-press the QR code below to visit the scheme pages of the Law Society of Hong Kong or the Hong Kong Bar Association for the scheme details and application documents. ## LexiHK Trial and Subscription Plans LexiHK currently offers four subscription plans — Individual, Professional, Team and Law Firm — with annual fees ranging from HK$10,000 to HK$40,000. All plans are valid for 12 months and come with one to five designated accounts and shared annual credits, with additional seats and credit top-up packs available on demand. You may scan the QR code above to apply for a LexiHK trial account. Eligible small and medium-sized law firms and newly qualified barristers may apply for up to HK$20,000 under the funding scheme above; subscriptions taken out during Legal Week enjoy double credits, and the full annual cost of the Individual and Professional plans can largely be covered by the subsidy. ## LexiHK Product Functions in Detail Built around the Hong Kong common law system and local legal materials, the functions currently on public display comprise four core capabilities — Legal Agent, Document Drafting, Legal Search and Contract Review — which respectively help break down tasks, organise materials, locate authorities and identify clause risks. The Legal Agent helps users organise the question and the next steps, while Document Drafting provides first drafts and structural references. Both are intended to save time on preliminary organisation and repetitive drafting; users remain responsible for verifying important facts and legal judgments. Legal Search helps users locate Hong Kong legislation, case law and related materials, with verifiable sources attached; Contract Review flags clauses and risk points that require attention, making it easier for professionals to examine them further. The LexiHK team of the Hong Kong Generative AI Research and Development Center (HKGAI) will continue to address the practical needs of Hong Kong’s legal services, improving its retrieval, analysis and drafting support so that the tool — with traceable sources and verifiable conclusions — can be better integrated into daily work. You are invited to experience LexiHK, HKGAI’s legal artificial intelligence product, and to appreciate the practical value of intelligent assistance in real work scenarios. Source: the WeChat article “LexiHK Debuts at Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 and Is Officially Selected as a Designated LawTech Service Provider of the Department of Justice”, published by “AI and Law Research” on 6 November 2026 (the original text was revised on the same date). This document is a formatted edition of the original article; all texts and images are taken from the original.

zh.title: LexiHK 首次亮相香港法律周 2026，正式入选律政司指定法律科技服务供应商
zh.summary: LexiHK 首次亮相香港法律周，开展现场演示及行业交流，并入选律政司法律科技资助计划指定服务供应商。
zh.body: ## 概览 11 月 2 日，香港法律周 2026 开幕，为期五天，主题为“携手创新：法律协作共创未来”。作为香港特别行政区律政司的年度旗舰活动，本届法律周汇聚来自世界各地的法律从业者、商界代表、政策制定者及国际组织代表。香港生成式人工智能研发中心（HKGAI）的法律人工智能产品 LexiHK 首次亮相，通过产品演示和专题分享，介绍技术在香港法律场景中的实际应用。 活动期间，律政司司长林定国、副司长张国钧及多位嘉宾到访 LexiHK 展位，与研发团队交流，了解产品功能及研发进展。LexiHK 负责人韩斯睿教授亦登上 Insight Stage，以真实法律工作场景为基础，演示 LexiHK 如何支持研究、优化流程及提高效率。 第一部分｜中联办、律政司及香港律师会嘉宾到访 LexiHK 展位 11 月 4 日，律政司司长林定国及副司长张国钧到访 LexiHK 展位，观看产品演示并与团队合影。双方就人工智能如何服务香港法律行业交换意见，团队重点介绍了 LexiHK 在运用本地法律知识、支持专业研究和辅助工作流程方面的实践。 11 月 5 日，中央人民政府驻香港特别行政区联络办公室副主任袁古洁及法律部部长刘春华到访 LexiHK 展位，了解产品研发成果及其面向香港法律行业的应用探索。 结合现场演示，团队介绍了 LexiHK 在支持法律研究、提高工作效率及满足本地专业需求方面的优势，展示人工智能赋能香港法律服务的潜力。 此外，香港律师会会长汤文龙、副会长 Amirali B. Nasir 等嘉宾亦到访展位，与团队交流并了解产品功能及应用场景。 团队向香港律师会介绍，LexiHK 针对香港律师日常工作需求，为法律研究、文件分析和起草提供智能辅助，并展示产品在提高效率、满足本地专业需求方面的优势，以及人工智能赋能香港法律服务的潜力。 第二部分｜Insight Stage 现场演示：法律工作的智能新体验 11 月 5 日上午，LexiHK 负责人韩斯睿教授在香港法律科技节 Insight Stage 进行专题分享及功能演示，将产品能力融入连续的法律工作场景，展示人工智能如何从具体问题出发，协助完成资料检索、信息整理和初稿准备。 演示沿着法律专业人士熟悉的工作步骤展开：输入问题、检索资料、逐步组织分析，呈现从研究需求到初步成果的完整过程。考虑到法律工作对核实依据的重视，演示亦展示相关来源如何支持用户进一步复核，将智能辅助与专业监督有效衔接。 从“找到资料”到“用好资料”，从单一任务到连续工作流程，LexiHK 展示了人工智能融入法律实务的更多可能。演示亦呈现产品背后的设计思路，将技术能力转化为专业人士能够理解、操作及评估的工作支持。 ## 第三部分｜深化行业交流，拓展法律科技合作 展览期间，LexiHK 团队与活跃于香港市场的法律科技企业及专业服务供应商代表深入交流，包括 LexisNexis 和 Wolters Kluwer，分享人工智能在法律研究、文件处理及专业工作流程中的应用经验，并探讨香港法律行业的实际需求及合作空间。 团队结合香港法律场景中的研发经验，介绍了产品在本地法律资源运用、信息溯源及智能辅助工作流程方面的探索，并与业界伙伴交流技术与专业服务的衔接。此次展览为拓展行业联系、深化合作认识提供重要机会；团队与多家参展机构代表合影，为后续产品完善及合作建立联系，共同推动香港法律科技的应用与发展。 第四部分｜LexiHK 入选律政司法律科技资助计划指定供应商 ## 律政司法律科技资助计划 11 月 3 日，律政司正式推出香港法律界订阅法律科技解决方案资助计划，LexiHK 入选 14 家指定法律科技服务供应商之一。计划属于行政长官《2026 年施政报告》的政策措施，由香港律师会与香港大律师公会共同管理，面向独资或不超过五名合伙人的律师事务所，以及执业年资不超过七年的大律师，以实报实销方式资助一年服务订阅。每名申请人最高可获港币 20,000 元，申请截止日期为 2027 年 1 月 29 日。 律师事务所可经香港律师会申请，大律师可经香港大律师公会申请。扫描或长按下方二维码，即可访问两会的计划网页，查阅详情及申请文件。 ## LexiHK 试用及订阅方案 LexiHK 目前提供个人、专业、团队及律师事务所四种订阅方案，年费为港币 10,000 至 40,000 元。各方案有效期为 12 个月，提供一至五个指定账户及共享年度额度，并可按需增购席位和额度补充包。 扫描上方二维码即可申请 LexiHK 试用账户。 符合资格的中小型律师事务所及新执业大律师可通过上述计划申请最高港币 20,000 元资助；法律周期间订阅可享双倍额度，个人及专业方案的全年费用基本可由资助覆盖。 ## LexiHK 产品功能详解 围绕香港普通法体系及本地法律资料，当前公开展示的功能包括法律智能体、文件起草、法律检索及合同审查四项核心能力，分别支持拆解任务、整理资料、定位依据及识别条款风险。 法律智能体协助用户梳理问题及后续步骤，文件起草提供初稿和结构参考。两者旨在节省前期整理及重复起草的时间；重要事实和法律判断仍需由用户核实。 法律检索协助用户定位香港法例、判例及相关资料，并附可核验来源；合同审查标记值得关注的条款及风险点，便于专业人士进一步审查。 香港生成式人工智能研发中心的 LexiHK 团队将继续回应香港法律服务的实际需求，完善检索、分析及起草支持，让来源可追溯、结论可核验的工具更好融入日常工作。欢迎体验 HKGAI 的法律人工智能产品 LexiHK，感受智能辅助在真实工作场景中的实用价值。 来源：“人工智能与法律研究”于 2026 年 11 月 6 日发布的微信公众号文章《LexiHK 首次亮相香港法律周 2026，正式入选律政司指定法律科技服务供应商》（原文于同日修订）。本稿为原文的排版版本，文字及图片均来自原文。

zhHant.title: LexiHK 首次亮相香港法律周 2026，正式入選律政司指定法律科技服務供應商
zhHant.summary: LexiHK 首次亮相香港法律周，開展現場演示及行業交流，併入選律政司法律科技資助計劃指定服務供應商。
zhHant.body: ## 概覽 11 月 2 日，香港法律周 2026 開幕，爲期五天，主題爲“攜手創新：法律協作共創未來”。作爲香港特別行政區律政司的年度旗艦活動，本屆法律周匯聚來自世界各地的法律從業者、商界代表、政策制定者及國際組織代表。香港生成式人工智能研發中心（HKGAI）的法律人工智能產品 LexiHK 首次亮相，通過產品演示和專題分享，介紹技術在香港法律場景中的實際應用。 活動期間，律政司司長林定國、副司長張國鈞及多位嘉賓到訪 LexiHK 展位，與研發團隊交流，瞭解產品功能及研發進展。LexiHK 負責人韓斯睿教授亦登上 Insight Stage，以真實法律工作場景爲基礎，演示 LexiHK 如何支持研究、優化流程及提高效率。 第一部分｜中聯辦、律政司及香港律師會嘉賓到訪 LexiHK 展位 11 月 4 日，律政司司長林定國及副司長張國鈞到訪 LexiHK 展位，觀看產品演示並與團隊合影。雙方就人工智能如何服務香港法律行業交換意見，團隊重點介紹了 LexiHK 在運用本地法律知識、支持專業研究和輔助工作流程方面的實踐。 11 月 5 日，中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區聯絡辦公室副主任袁古潔及法律部部長劉春華到訪 LexiHK 展位，瞭解產品研發成果及其面向香港法律行業的應用探索。 結合現場演示，團隊介紹了 LexiHK 在支持法律研究、提高工作效率及滿足本地專業需求方面的優勢，展示人工智能賦能香港法律服務的潛力。 此外，香港律師會會長湯文龍、副會長 Amirali B. Nasir 等嘉賓亦到訪展位，與團隊交流並瞭解產品功能及應用場景。 團隊向香港律師會介紹，LexiHK 針對香港律師日常工作需求，爲法律研究、文件分析和起草提供智能輔助，並展示產品在提高效率、滿足本地專業需求方面的優勢，以及人工智能賦能香港法律服務的潛力。 第二部分｜Insight Stage 現場演示：法律工作的智能新體驗 11 月 5 日上午，LexiHK 負責人韓斯睿教授在香港法律科技節 Insight Stage 進行專題分享及功能演示，將產品能力融入連續的法律工作場景，展示人工智能如何從具體問題出發，協助完成資料檢索、信息整理和初稿準備。 演示沿着法律專業人士熟悉的工作步驟展開：輸入問題、檢索資料、逐步組織分析，呈現從研究需求到初步成果的完整過程。考慮到法律工作對覈實依據的重視，演示亦展示相關來源如何支持用戶進一步複覈，將智能輔助與專業監督有效銜接。 從“找到資料”到“用好資料”，從單一任務到連續工作流程，LexiHK 展示了人工智能融入法律實務的更多可能。演示亦呈現產品背後的設計思路，將技術能力轉化爲專業人士能夠理解、操作及評估的工作支持。 ## 第三部分｜深化行業交流，拓展法律科技合作 展覽期間，LexiHK 團隊與活躍於香港市場的法律科技企業及專業服務供應商代表深入交流，包括 LexisNexis 和 Wolters Kluwer，分享人工智能在法律研究、文件處理及專業工作流程中的應用經驗，並探討香港法律行業的實際需求及合作空間。 團隊結合香港法律場景中的研發經驗，介紹了產品在本地法律資源運用、信息溯源及智能輔助工作流程方面的探索，並與業界夥伴交流技術與專業服務的銜接。此次展覽爲拓展行業聯繫、深化合作認識提供重要機會；團隊與多家參展機構代表合影，爲後續產品完善及合作建立聯繫，共同推動香港法律科技的應用與發展。 第四部分｜LexiHK 入選律政司法律科技資助計劃指定供應商 ## 律政司法律科技資助計劃 11 月 3 日，律政司正式推出香港法律界訂閱法律科技解決方案資助計劃，LexiHK 入選 14 家指定法律科技服務供應商之一。計劃屬於行政長官《2026 年施政報告》的政策措施，由香港律師會與香港大律師公會共同管理，面向獨資或不超過五名合夥人的律師事務所，以及執業年資不超過七年的大律師，以實報實銷方式資助一年服務訂閱。每名申請人最高可獲港幣 20,000 元，申請截止日期爲 2027 年 1 月 29 日。 律師事務所可經香港律師會申請，大律師可經香港大律師公會申請。掃描或長按下方二維碼，即可訪問兩會的計劃網頁，查閱詳情及申請文件。 ## LexiHK 試用及訂閱方案 LexiHK 目前提供個人、專業、團隊及律師事務所四種訂閱方案，年費爲港幣 10,000 至 40,000 元。各方案有效期爲 12 個月，提供一至五個指定賬戶及共享年度額度，並可按需增購席位和額度補充包。 掃描上方二維碼即可申請 LexiHK 試用賬戶。 符合資格的中小型律師事務所及新執業大律師可通過上述計劃申請最高港幣 20,000 元資助；法律週期間訂閱可享雙倍額度，個人及專業方案的全年費用基本可由資助覆蓋。 ## LexiHK 產品功能詳解 圍繞香港普通法體系及本地法律資料，當前公開展示的功能包括法律智能體、文件起草、法律檢索及合同審查四項核心能力，分別支持拆解任務、整理資料、定位依據及識別條款風險。 法律智能體協助用戶梳理問題及後續步驟，文件起草提供初稿和結構參考。兩者旨在節省前期整理及重複起草的時間；重要事實和法律判斷仍需由用戶覈實。 法律檢索協助用戶定位香港法例、判例及相關資料，並附可覈驗來源；合同審查標記值得關注的條款及風險點，便於專業人士進一步審查。 香港生成式人工智能研發中心的 LexiHK 團隊將繼續回應香港法律服務的實際需求，完善檢索、分析及起草支持，讓來源可追溯、結論可覈驗的工具更好融入日常工作。歡迎體驗 HKGAI 的法律人工智能產品 LexiHK，感受智能輔助在真實工作場景中的實用價值。 來源：“人工智能與法律研究”於 2026 年 11 月 6 日發佈的微信公衆號文章《LexiHK 首次亮相香港法律周 2026，正式入選律政司指定法律科技服務供應商》（原文於同日修訂）。本稿爲原文的排版版本，文字及圖片均來自原文。
